articles.summary: Alpine Texworld's IPO had a weak debut, with only 0.28 times subscription on Day 1. Retail and NII segments saw low bids, while QIB was fully subscribed. The company aims to raise ₹126 crore for expanding production in Ahmedabad and paying off debt.

articles.title: IBM shares plunge 26% after Q2 earnings forecast falls short of estimates
articles.summary: IBM shares plunged 26% to $228 after Q2 sales fell below estimates, with revenue at $17.2 billion. CEO Arvind Krishna noted that customers are limiting spending. The stock faces its largest intraday decline since the 1980s. Other software firms also experienced losses amid these results.

articles.title: SBI Funds Management IPO subscribed 0.71x on Day 1; NII portion leads demand, GMP signals 16% listing premium
articles.summary: SBI Funds Management's IPO saw strong investor interest on Day 1, with overall subscription at 0.71 times. Retail and NII segments showed positive engagement, while QIB interest was lower. The IPO, valued at ₹9,812.91 crore, is an Offer for Sale with SBI and Amundi as main shareholders.

articles.title: US stock market today: S&P, Dow futures steady as investors await inflation data; crude at one-month high
